title: Book One · Chapter 130: The White Space
story:
Mei wants to take her picture down on Friday.

Ronan is standing by the wall when she tells Miss Wu. He looks at the little people in their doorways.

“But there are three days left.”

“I want to give it to my aunt,” Mei says. “We are going to her home tomorrow.”

“You could give it on Monday.”

“We are going tomorrow.”

Miss Wu takes the top corners down. She asks Ronan to hold the bottom. He holds it so the paper will not fall. He would like the picture to stay. But Mei wants to give it to her aunt.

Mei lays it flat on her desk. There is a white space on the wall now. Mr Qiu's table drawing is beside the empty space. Ronan liked having both pictures up together.

“We need another picture,” Ronan says.

“You could draw one,” Mei tells him.

“I cannot draw all those people.”

“You can choose other people for your drawing.”

He looks at the empty place again. Then he gets a sheet of paper. He begins to draw the black cat at the green gate. The cat's ears are easy. The feet are not. His cat has four very large feet. They look like shoes.

Leo comes over and makes a soft cat sound. Then he looks at the feet.

“A cat going to school.”

Ronan laughs, but he puts his hand over the drawing.

“I am not finished.”

Leo goes away. Ronan keeps working. He makes the feet smaller. Then he rubs them out again. The paper tears under the rubber.

At break Mei sits beside him. She has put her own picture safely between two boards.

“May I look?”

He lifts his hand. She does not laugh. She looks at the head and then at the torn place.

“The ears are good.”

“The feet are gone.”

“Put the cat behind the pot.”

He looks at her. Then he draws a large round pot. It covers the torn place in the paper. The cat sits behind it. Now there are only two small feet to show.

“It sits behind the pot sometimes,” he says.

“Then go and look before you finish.”

The space on the wall is still empty. At home Ronan tries a second sheet. He wants to try again. Then he will go outside. He draws two legs and a tail. The tail ends up on the wrong side of the body. He turns the paper over and begins the wall instead.

Dad looks in from the yard.

“You have made a very fine wall.”

“There is no cat yet.”

“The wall does not know that.”

Ronan smiles and makes the top line a little rougher. Some bricks stick out a little. He has seen that on the real wall. He can get that part right without any help.

On Saturday he sits in the yard with his paper. The cat will not stay still. It walks along the wall, looks at him, and jumps down out of sight.

Ronan draws the wall first. He adds the pot. Then he waits.

Mum comes out. “Why are you so quiet?” she asks.

“The cat has not agreed to sit.”

“A common problem with cats.”

At last the black head appears above the wall. Ronan draws the ears quickly. He saw the cat for a moment. Now he draws the rest from memory.

On Monday Mei's picture is still gone. Ronan's cat takes its place. The shoes are gone too. “Has the cat left school?” Leo asks. Ronan tells him it was never a good student.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：take down＝取下；out of sight＝看不见；rub out＝擦去。

情节提示：pot＝花盆；tail＝尾巴；torn＝撕破的。

理解：1. Mei 为什么提前取走自己的画？2. Ronan 怎样解决猫脚画不好的问题？
